title: 第3章 成长三第4章 天赋鉴定
content_zh:
“你们在干嘛呢？”
三人正在翻转手里的鱼，防止烤焦，身后传来一声糯糯的女声。
“在烤鱼啊”
瑞隆想都没想就回答道，然后三人一回头，真白！
也就是皮肤白，当头一个身材高挑明目皓齿，清艳脱俗的样子映入眼中，黄色的长头发，不过看起来年龄不大就是了。
“看什么看，你们几个都注意点！”
女孩还没说话，身边的人看着三人都目不转睛的盯着女孩看就提醒道。
“哦，对不起，主要是她长得太美了，是我见过最漂亮的女孩子。”
吉恩马上收回乱看的眼睛，然后看着女孩秋水般的眼眸说道反正夸人不犯错。
随后看着女孩身后站着6个人，有两个婷婷玉立跟女孩差不多大的女孩，长的也很好看，就是没有女孩有气质，其他四个是侍卫，应该就是前面远处的那几个人，不知道他们是来海边干嘛的。
瑞隆跟凯文两人才缓过劲来，确实好像比他们初级学校的校花都漂亮！
“没事，没事呵呵，你们在烤什么鱼啊，这么香？”
女孩问道，她本来也是要回去吃午饭，路过这里闻到被风吹过来一阵阵的香味就过来看看。
“就是海里的鱼啊，这是鲷鱼请你吃。”
凯文马上道，顺便还把手上烤的差不多的鱼送了过去。
“对啊，我们是斯凯格丝初级学校的学生，你们想吃我们请你们。”
吉恩马上接着道，他发现这几个好像不是斯凯格丝海港的人，应该是外地人，搞不好还有可能是波涛渔人，别刚刚三人乱看，得罪了人家！
“哦，我们这边也有三个女孩子，你们这边一条鱼我们三个人怎么分呢？”
女孩漆黑的眼珠子转了转说道。
“那还用说，瑞隆吉恩我们请她们三位小姐先吃吧？然后我们在烤。”

凯文说完抢过两人手上的烤鱼一起递过去。
“…”
吉恩张了张嘴没说话，心里想着：兄弟天狗是没有好下场的！
不过也没说啥，瑞隆就翻了翻白眼，也没说话，给美女一个面子，他唯一的爱好就是吃，妹子只会影响他的进食的速度，凯文在学校稍微有点女孩缘，吉恩就是个隐形绝缘体…
然后三个妹纸还真的坐下来了！
吉恩心里一阵mmp这个世界怎么这么奇怪？按照正常情理这女孩看起来也不应该看的上他们的烤鱼吧？
“嗯，确实不错，看不出来，你们的烤鱼还是有几分水平的，我还以为你们斯凯格丝海港只有生吃跟煮汤呢！”
女孩皱着好看的眉头道。
听这话可能她们那边也吃烤鱼。
“嘿嘿，这是吉恩教我们的，吉恩烤的最好吃了！”
凯文说完还推了推吉恩。
“还好吧，我们再给大家烤几只鱼，”
吉恩没办法只能接着烤，不就是烤鱼吗？那个夜生活丰富的兄弟不会点烤鱼烤肉的本事？再说了那个年代华夏男同胞做饭都是必备的生活技能！
最后所有的鱼都烤完了，女孩一起七人加上吉恩他们三人，女孩一人就吃了两条鱼…最后女孩说她的名字月夜.波涛，感谢几人的烤鱼，然后带着人走了，最后就是三人没有吃饱…半大小子吃垮老子，三人都在长身体阶段，然后吉恩又带着瑞隆凯文烤了些就近抓的壳类生物，最后回到家已经下午3点多了，又被米莉叨叨了一顿，然后做作业，吃饭练习姿势，睡觉。
别跟我说都一个成年人了还跟个孩子一样，你要知道吉恩身上有ai定位监控（保护），还有身边的人，他除了自己的大脑就没有自由了，从地球人的角度来说是这样的，再说了反正这辈子可能回不去急也没用，还不如就当这是人生中的趟意外的旅行，不如试着渡过一个跟地球不一样的世界？这里人也单纯男俊女靓！
主要的是这里只规定你必须结婚，却没有限制你跟几个妹纸结婚…自由的时间总是过的很快，又到了周一。
content_en:
"What are you doing?"
The three of them were turning the fish in their hands to prevent it from burning when a waxy female voice came from behind them.
"Grilling fish"
Ruilon answered without thinking, and then the three of them turned around, Zhenbai!
That is to say, the skin is white, the first one is tall, has bright eyes, white teeth, and a refined and elegant appearance. He has long yellow hair, but he doesn't look very old.
"What are you looking at? Please pay attention!"
Before the girl could speak, the people around her reminded her as they saw the three of them staring at the girl intently.
"Oh, I'm sorry. The main reason is that she is so beautiful. She is the most beautiful girl I have ever seen."
Jean immediately withdrew his glaring eyes, then looked into the girl's autumn eyes and said, anyway, you won't make mistakes when you praise someone.
Then I saw 6 people standing behind the girl. There were two girls who were about the same age as her. They were also very good-looking, but not as elegant as the girls. The other four were guards, and they should be the ones in the distance in front. I don’t know what they came to the beach for.
Ruilon and Kevin finally regained their composure, and they indeed seemed to be more beautiful than the school belle of their junior school!
"It's okay, it's okay haha, what kind of fish are you grilling? It's so delicious?"
The girl asked. She was originally going back for lunch. When she passed by, she smelled the fragrance blown by the wind and came over to take a look.
"It's just a fish from the sea. This is a snapper for you to eat."
Kevin said immediately, and by the way, he sent over the fish that was almost grilled.
"Yes, we are students at Skaggs Junior School. If you want to eat, we will treat you."
Gene immediately went on to say that he found that these people did not seem to be from Skaggs Harbor. They should be outsiders, and maybe they were wave fishermen. Don't offend others by just looking around at the three of them!
"Oh, we also have three girls here. How can we divide the fish you have here between the three of us?"
The girl rolled her dark eyes and said.
"That goes without saying, Ruilongjien, let's treat the three ladies to eat first? Then we'll bake it."
After Kevin finished speaking, he snatched the grilled fish from both of them and handed it over to them together.
“…”
Jean opened his mouth but said nothing, thinking to himself: Brother Tengu will not end well!
But without saying anything, Ruilon rolled his eyes without saying a word, giving face to the beautiful woman. His only hobby is eating, and girls will only affect his eating speed. Kevin has a slight affinity with girls in school, and Gene is an invisible insulator...
Then the three girls actually sat down!
Gene felt in his heart: Why is this world so strange? According to normal logic, this girl shouldn't be attracted to their grilled fish, right?
"Well, it's really good. I can't tell, but your grilled fish is quite good. I thought your Skaggs Harbor only served it raw and boiled in soup!"
The girl said with a nice frown.
From what I heard, maybe they also eat grilled fish there.
"Hehe, this is what Jean taught us. Jean's baking is the most delicious!"
After Kevin finished speaking, he pushed Gene.
"It's okay, let's grill some more fish for everyone,"
Jean had no choice but to continue grilling, isn't it just grilled fish? That brother who has a lot of night life doesn't know how to order grilled fish and barbecue? Besides, in that era, cooking was a necessary life skill for Chinese men!
In the end, all the fish were grilled. There were seven girls, including Gene and three others. The girl ate two fishes alone... Finally, the girl said her name, Yue Ye. Bo Tao, thanked several people for the grilled fish, and then left with them. In the end, the three of them were not full... half The eldest son defeated me, and the three of them were all in the growth stage. Then Gene took Ruilon and Kevin to roast some shellfish that they had caught nearby. It was already past 3 pm when they finally got home, and Millie nagged them again. Then they did their homework, ate, practiced their postures, and went to bed.
Don't tell me you're an adult and you're still following meJust like a child, you have to know that Jean has AI positioning monitoring (protection) on his body, and the people around him. He has no freedom except his own brain. From the perspective of an earthling, this is true. Besides, there is no point in rushing back in this life anyway. Why not treat it as an unexpected trip in life? Why not try to live in a world different from the earth? The people here are also pure, handsome men and beautiful women!
The main thing is that here it is only stipulated that you must get married, but there is no restriction on how many girls you can marry... The free time always passes quickly, and it's Monday again.
